description: Unify explicit paste-to-card conversion for manual creation and the add/edit question modal, preserving structured imports, native fallback, and stale optional SmolLM2 protection.
steps: Create a typed clipboard-authoring helper and pure tests that map single_pair and question_answer to one card, leave bulk/list/enumeration formats to manual preview, preserve null/empty/native fallback, and call buildClipboardQuestionPrompt exactly once.

Refactor ManualQuizCreator.tsx prompt and identification target-answer paste handlers to use the helper; retain container handling only for bulk imports and leave metadata Term / Grading Period controls unparsed.

Refactor QuizQuestionFormModal.tsx paste handlers for question and typed/identification answer fields in both add and edit modes; guard asynchronous SmolLM2 results against later user edits, paste events, close, or index changes.
Verify QuizOverviewClient.tsx continues to own modal add/edit state without duplicate paste handling, and perform browser checks for all authoring boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Pasting a recognized definition into a manual question prompt or target identification term/answer creates one identification card using the deterministic prompt converter.
The same behavior works in add-question and edit-question modal flows, without double application or ordinary typing interception.
Structured Q&A, bulk imports, enumeration blocks, empty input, parser-null, and unavailable/failing SmolLM2 preserve existing fallback behavior.
The metadata grading-period Term / Grading Period field remains ordinary metadata entry unless browser evidence proves the report refers to it.
Focused parser, authoring-helper, and prompt tests plus web typecheck pass.
verification: Browser verification of manual, add, and edit paste boundaries and native fallback
findings: Implemented the shared explicit paste-to-card flow. Single pairs and Q&A pairs become one identification card; bulk/list/question-answer-list/enumeration formats remain preview/native paths. Manual metadata Term / Grading Period controls remain ordinary metadata inputs, and QuizOverviewClient remains the modal add/edit state owner without duplicate paste handling.
implementation_details: Added apps/web/lib/clipboardAuthoring.ts with the typed createClipboardAuthoringCard helper. It returns null for parser-null, empty, bulk, list, and enumeration formats, and calls buildClipboardQuestionPrompt once for single_pair input.
Added apps/web/lib/__tests__/clipboardAuthoring.test.ts covering single pairs, Q&A pairs, unsupported structured formats, null input, and prompt-builder call count.

Refactored ManualQuizCreator prompt and identification-answer paste boundaries to use the helper while retaining preview handling for structured imports and guarding optional SmolLM2 results against edits, paste events, unmount, and question index changes.

Refactored QuizQuestionFormModal prompt and typed/identification answer paste boundaries for add and edit modes. Pending SmolLM2 results are invalidated by later edits, paste events, close, question/open changes, and type changes.
Preserved native paste fallback for parser-null, empty, unsupported structured, and unavailable/failing SmolLM2 cases.

Manually verify paste propagation and native fallback in manual creation, add-question, and edit-question flows; verify rich-text/native undo remains intact; verify the metadata Term / Grading Period field is not parsed.
source_discrepancies: QuizOverviewClient.tsx was inspected and left unchanged as the owner of modal add/edit state. The actual prompt integration remains apps/web/lib/clipboardQuestionPrompt.ts, not the absent apps/web/lib/ai/clipboardQuestionPrompt.ts.
later_features: Do not modify apps/web/hooks/useQuizSession.ts or broaden converter behavior. Browser verification remains the follow-up requirement for explicit paste event propagation, rich-text/native undo, stale SmolLM2 cancellation, and the meaning of the reported term field.
